Name: INTERACTIVE_SMOKE_PARAM_ST
Description: Defines touchable smoke: particle effects spawned around an impact point that attach further effects to a character that touches them.

Fields.Name: Particle Generation Count
Fields.Description: Number of smoke particle effects to generate.

Fields.Name: Duration
Fields.Description: Lifetime of the smoke particle effects. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Radius
Fields.Description: The radius of the touchable smoke. In metres.

Fields.Name: Interaction Time
Fields.Description: Time during which touching the smoke can still generate the additional (attaching) particle effects. In seconds.

Fields.Name: Maximum Distance from Impact for Generation
Fields.Description: The smoke particle effects are generated at horizontal positions within this distance of the impact point. In metres.

Fields.Name: Smoke Particle ID
Fields.Description: Particle effect that forms the main body of the touchable smoke at the impact point.

Fields.Name: Smoke Particle ID: On Touch
Fields.Description: Particle effect that attaches to the core (fixed position) after touching the smoke.

Fields.Name: Smoke Particle ID: On Touch (Parts)
Fields.Description: Particle effect that attaches all over the body after touching the smoke, generated at random parts.
